_readme: Example severity scoring profile for the STRIDE threat modeling tool.
Load it with Scoring... > Import .json, or paste it into the profile editor.
Score = baseScores[rule base rating] + categoryPoints[STRIDE letter]
+ aggravatorPoints that apply - mitigatorPoints that apply.
The score is then mapped onto the highest level whose 'min' it reaches.
name: Example: healthcare four-tier scale
description: Weights confidentiality and privilege escalation more heavily, on the basis that regulated patient data is the dominant risk.
